notes.title: Minor Update - Loc font changes
notes.notes: Improved readability of Chinese font and addressed some minor issues with certain Brazilian Portuguese characters.

notes.title: Minor patch to fix endgame exploit
notes.notes: Fixed issue where in some circumstances the "continue" button would allow the player to replay the last turn of a round over and over again

notes.title: Steam Deck Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Sound the horns, Tree Kingdoms runs on Steam Deck! [/h1][p][/p][h3]In the run up to our Next Fest demo we've been iterating away with lots of fixes and updates - but the most exciting is having the game running and feeling good on Steam Deck.   We've had Steam Deck support in mind for this game since Day 1 so its super thrilling for us to get it into our players hands with our Next Fest demo - which is now live![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504207/2cc050c053c6ea44c1fb79e7016993e96788c3e5.jpg"][/img]  [/h3][h1] [/h1][p][/p][h1]We need your feedback! [/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504207/40ba93faf56e8d424eb3f2c0a080e39ac81db852.png"][/img]Its certainly not going to be perfect the first time out, so we'd really appreciate any feedback you might have on how it plays. Do the controls feel right? Are there aspects you'd change, or things you'd expect to happen with certain inputs which we're not doing? 

Anything you let us know about will help us improve the experience before we submit the game for Steam Deck verification, and make the game the best it can be for launch. 


Let us know either in our community pages or via the feedback link in the demo itself. 
We hope you enjoy! 

And as always a big thank you to everyone who's RT'd, Wishlisted, and shared the game so far. It means the world to this tiny team. 


And of course.... 
[b]If you like what we're making - tell someone about it![/b] [/h3]
